displaySummary.zh: 大核 CNN · 结构重参数化

displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists RepLKNet as row 4 in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table, preserving Xiaohan Ding and Xiangyu Zhang as the official contributor prefix. The associated CVPR 2022 paper asks whether modern CNNs can recover global context by using a few very large kernels instead of repeatedly stacking small ones.

RepLKNet uses re-parameterized large depth-wise convolutions with kernels as large as 31x31, then merges the training-time branches into a simpler deployment path. The paper reports competitive ImageNet and ADE20K results and finds that large-kernel CNNs have larger effective receptive fields and stronger shape bias than small-kernel counterparts.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表视觉领域第 4 行列出 RepLKNet，并把丁霄汉、张祥雨作为官方主要人物前缀保留。关联的 CVPR 2022 论文重新提出一个基础问题：现代 CNN 能否通过少量超大卷积核获得更广的上下文，而不是反复堆叠小卷积核。

RepLKNet 使用最大 31×31 的重参数化大核深度卷积，并把训练期的多分支结构合并为更简单的部署路径。论文报告了有竞争力的 ImageNet 与 ADE20K 结果，同时发现大核 CNN 相比小核模型具有更大的有效感受野和更强的形状偏置。

html.en: Modern CNN design had converged on stacks of small kernels, while vision transformers renewed interest in obtaining broad spatial context. RepLKNet revisited the largely abandoned large-kernel path and asked whether a carefully engineered CNN could recover transformer-like context without abandoning convolution.
html.zh: 现代 CNN 设计曾逐渐收敛到反复堆叠小卷积核，而视觉 Transformer 的兴起重新凸显了广域空间上下文的重要性。RepLKNet 回到一度被放弃的大卷积核路线，探索精心设计的 CNN 能否在保留卷积的同时获得类似 Transformer 的上下文范围。

html.en: RepLKNet uses large depth-wise convolutions, reaching 31x31 kernels, and applies structural re-parameterization so training-time branches can be merged for deployment. The larger kernels expand the effective receptive field while the depth-wise form and branch fusion keep the design practical for image classification and dense prediction.
html.zh: RepLKNet 使用最大 31×31 的大核深度卷积，并通过结构重参数化把训练期分支合并为部署结构。大卷积核扩大有效感受野，深度卷积与分支融合则让这一设计能够实际用于图像分类和稠密预测任务。

html.en: Experts generally treat RepLKNet as an important demonstration that convolutional networks still had underexplored architectural scale, especially in kernel size and effective receptive field. Its longer legacy lies in reopening large-kernel CNN research and influencing later designs that combine convolutional inductive bias with the scale and task generality associated with transformers.
html.zh: 专家通常把 RepLKNet 视为一个重要证明：卷积网络在卷积核尺寸和有效感受野等架构尺度上仍有未充分探索的空间。它的长期影响在于重新推动大核 CNN 研究，并影响后来把卷积归纳偏置与 Transformer 式规模化、任务通用性结合起来的设计。
